t: This row, numbers 12 to 34 Connaught Street, is a listed building in Westminster, just north of Hyde Park. It was designed by Samuel Pepys Cockerell, an English architect who lived from 1754 to 1827. That puts the design firmly in the Georgian period. The material I have on him is slight, so I'll simply say that you're standing in front of a long terrace by a architect of that era.
